content.short: Greedy World is a decentralized game where players collect treasures.
content.description: Greedy World is a third‑generation GameFi title that drops players into a snake battle royale, where you collect tokens, outmaneuver rivals, and work toward withdrawing your gains. Set in a decentralized world, it argues for a healthier, more compliant and diverse Web3 development path beyond the traditional mine‑withdraw‑sell loop. The game blends adventure with greed as a core theme, inviting players to strategize, take risks, and pursue ambition within a community‑driven ecosystem.
content.meta: Greedy World is a 3rd Gen GameFi with snake battle royale and token collection. Discover Greedy World and other Decentralized Games on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
